record_version.description: Version of the record's own content, bumped whenever the record changes.

Dataset.description: A dataset, or collection of datasets, curated for publication and the role held in curating it. Each record is one JSON file under datasets/.

description.description: Paragraphs of plain text describing the curation work, in which **double asterisks** mark emphasis.

group.description: Research group that produced the data, e.g. "Leifer Lab".

institution.description: Institution the group belongs to, e.g. "Princeton University". Omitted for groups that span several institutions.

name.description: Title of the dataset or collection.

record_version.description: Version of the record's own content, bumped whenever the record changes.

role.description: Role held in curating the data, e.g. "Primary Engineer" or "Supervisor".

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written against. The record may still be valid under other schema versions; this names the version at the time it was written.

DatasetLinks.description: Resources related to a dataset, keyed by type.

code.description: Source code that converted the data to a standard format.

dataset.description: The published data, e.g. a Dandiset on the DANDI Archive.

manuscript.description: The associated publication, ideally as a DOI link.

notebook.description: Jupyter Notebook(s) demonstrating how to access and analyze the data.

DatasetLinks.title: DatasetLinks

Project.description: A software project and the role held on it. Each record is one JSON file under projects/.

contribution.description: Summary of the contributions made to the project. Required when the role is "Contributor".

description.description: Paragraphs of plain text describing the project and the contributions made to it, in which **double asterisks** mark emphasis.

end_date.description: When involvement in the project ended. Omitted while it is ongoing.

logo.description: Path to the project's logo relative to the website root (the file itself lives under src/public/), e.g. "img/guide_logo.png".

record_version.description: Version of the record's own content, bumped whenever the record changes.

role.description: Role held on the project, e.g. "Lead Developer" or "Contributor".

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written against. The record may still be valid under other schema versions; this names the version at the time it was written.

start_date.description: When involvement in the project began.

url.description: Primary link for the project, such as its source repository or homepage.
